let step = 8.0D

hilbert(depth: int, angle: double) is

        return
    fi

    pen.turn(angle)
    hilbert(depth - 1, -angle)
    pen.forward(step)

    pen.turn(-angle)
    hilbert(depth - 1, angle)
    pen.forward(step)
    hilbert(depth - 1, angle)

    pen.turn(-angle)
    pen.forward(step)
    hilbert(depth - 1, -angle)
    pen.turn(angle)
